summary: ATV crash fatality: Maree Ekstrom, 60, of Conifer killed in an ATV crash in the national forest near the Park/Teller county line; multi-agency response (Park County SO, PCSAR, Lake George Fire Protection District, Ute Pass Regional Ambulance, Flight for Life) navigated rivers and steep terrain with ropes to locate and recover the body
location: national forest near the Park County/Teller County line
responding_agency: Park County Search and Rescue; Park County Sheriff's Office
notes: Crash occurred during the night of Tuesday 2024-10-01 (weekday-verified); body found and recovered on the morning of Thursday 2024-10-03. PCSO called it the second ATV fatality in Park County in the past two months — the first (~Aug 2024) incident is not yet identified (pending lead).
